$description: BoxPlot (platform/charts/BoxPlot.jsx, library wave 9, lane B): its component tokens. The box and the outliers are the frame's mark and point (chart-*); these draw the whiskers and the median. No new color: existing roles.

box-plot-whisker-color.$description: Box plot: the whiskers and their caps (the range within 1.5 × the box).

box-plot-median-color.$description: Box plot: the median line across the box, in the surface color so it shows on the box's data color.

box-plot-median-width.$description: Box plot: the median line's width.

box-plot-outlier-radius.$description: Box plot: the radius of an outlier point (the frame's point, with its ring).
